records.title: Members Of Parliament, Annual
records.footnote: Data comprise elected Members of Parliament (MPs), Non-Constituency MPs and Nominated MPs, and are based on the start of each Parliament term. Data from year 2012 to 2015 are based on the start of the 12th Parliament term. Data from year 2016 to 2019 are based on the start of the 13th Parliament term. Data from year 2020 to 2024 are based on the start of the 14th Parliament term. Data from year 2025 are based on the start of the 15th Parliament term. There were no Nominated MPs in year 2025 as they were appointed in Jan 2026. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 5.5.1 and 16.7.1.
